acceptance: Absence.detail goes through the same redaction as excerpt()
parse_reset handles the Claude and Codex reset formats, with tests from captured messages
description: Two Low findings deferred on #2769. (1) The Claude auth pattern captures the rest of the error line into Absence.detail, which is published in the report without the credential and long-token redaction that excerpt() applies. (2) parse_reset understands only "Resets in <duration>". Claude's "resets 7:50pm (America/New_York)" and Codex's "try again at Oct 9th, 2026 6:08 PM" leave reset_at empty, so pool blocks are not kept between runs.
